title: Fp prime Montgomery batch SIMD for general 64-bit primes (AVX2)
description:
Add an AVX2 batch Montgomery kernel for `Fp

` at general 64-bit primes. Currently only `Fp<65537>` and `Fp<2^31-1>` have batch SIMD; everything else falls through to scalar element-wise. Stays on MSRV 1.80 — IFMA52 is a separate dependent task. ## Background Generic `Fp

` Montgomery batch ops fall back to scalar element-wise loops; only `Fp<65537>` and `Fp<2^{31}-1>` have batch SIMD. The 64-bit primes used by tower extensions (`gfpn`) have no batch path. The fix adds a `MontgomeryFns` set in `gf2-kernels-simd` and a `simd::maybe_montgomery()` accessor: - V3 SIMD via $32 \times 4$ limb decomposition on AVX2: split each 64-bit Montgomery operand into two 32-bit limbs, pack 4 elements per YMM, multiply with `_mm256_mul_epu32`, propagate carries explicitly. If the AVX2 path measures below $1.5\times$, a follow-up dependent task `C3-ifma52` may be opened that adds an AVX-512 IFMA52 path (52-bit unsigned multiply-add via `_mm512_madd52lo_epu64` / `_mm512_madd52hi_epu64`) on a Rust-1.89 branch. That sub-task requires explicit user MSRV-bump approval per `escalation-policy.md` and is compile-gated behind `#[cfg(all(target_arch = ..., target_feature = ...))]` with the AVX2 path as fallback. ## Success Criteria - [hard] Bit-exact vs. scalar Montgomery for every prime in the existing `proofs/` test suite. - [hard] Existing Mersenne/Fermat specialisations unchanged. - [hard] Lean4 proofs still build (`./scripts/verify-lean.sh`). - [hard] No `unsafe` outside `gf2-kernels-simd`. - [hard] Sibling `*.asm.txt` artefact regenerated and shows `_mm256_mul_epu32` plus carry propagation. - [hard] `perf stat -r 10` capture before/after recorded. - [hard] No MSRV bump within this task — IFMA52 is a separate user-approval-gated task that is opened only on demonstrated need. - [aspirational] $\geq 1.5\times$ geomean over scalar fallback for at least one general 64-bit prime at the design batch size. ## Notes Bench: `fp_specialized`, `fieldvec_dot_product` (existing, pinned by I1). Spec doc: `dev/plans/gf2_core_ppc_spiral.md`.
